text:
- Locate `paymentsign` by description (angled display stand / smooth base / black stand); ignore implausible flat/low hits. Use right when no arm named; if left required, home/re-locate and retry body-centre top-down; if lost, do not sweep.
- Grasp board body centre across narrow side. If UNREACHABLE/SLIPPED, home, re-locate, retry. If fallen, grasp a stable visible end/part; avoid rim/edge and unseen left-end grasps.
- Lift 7–12 cm to clear table. Put it back down on the table near where it was (ref table, an xy the arm reaches) with `face="front"` and `face_now="back"`: it starts with the QR side facing away from the robot (the demos turn it by about half a turn, 140-180 deg), so it must be turned around; if UNREACHABLE pick a closer xy; the exact position does not matter.
- If `RELEASED_NOT_SEEN`, home, re-locate with description, inspect images; if not visible, do not done. Never finish with `turn_deg=0` or empty checks.
- Before done verify `on_table`, `upright`, `released`, and visually confirm the QR side faces the robot. Leave other objects untouched.
goal: Paymentsign standing upright on the table, QR side facing the robot, released; position on the table does not matter.
